title: Hoʻonani Village housing and well funding
summary: On April 24, the committee set aside up to $9 million in excise tax funds for well and water work at the Hoʻonani Village mixed use project. A member said the project can return for a budget amendment to remove the condition if it becomes unfeasible. Bills 163, 164 and 165, which would change land plans and zoning for the Kahului housing, were heard in November; the developer plans 1,608 apartments and will seek $35 million to $45 million in county money.

timeline.text: A member said the whole town burnt down and the project rebuilds county assets as prices rise.
